grid.grid-template-rows: [[[ return states[variables.var_assistsat_entity]?.attributes?.mode === 'night' ? 'calc(88px * var(--va-clock-shortcut-scale, 1)) minmax(0,1fr)' : 'calc(88px * var(--va-clock-shortcut-scale, 1)) minmax(0,1fr) auto'; ]]]

grid.grid-template-areas: [[[ let h = 'heading'; try { if (window.ViewAssistApp?.getViewAssistCAUUID() === "vision-148898ba-5dcd-43e8-be10-723352651736") h = 'study_navigation'; } catch (e) {} return states[variables.var_assistsat_entity]?.attributes?.mode === 'night' ? `"${h}" "face"` : `"${h}" "face" "weather"`; ]]]

card.height: [[[ const displayState = states[variables.var_assistsat_entity]; const mode = displayState?.attributes?.screen_mode; return !displayState || ['no_hide','hide_sidebar'].includes(mode) ? 'calc(100dvh - var(--header-height, 56px))' : '100dvh'; ]]]

card.min-height: [[[ const displayState = states[variables.var_assistsat_entity]; const mode = displayState?.attributes?.screen_mode; return !displayState || ['no_hide','hide_sidebar'].includes(mode) ? 'calc(100dvh - var(--header-height, 56px))' : '100dvh'; ]]]

card.max-height: [[[ const displayState = states[variables.var_assistsat_entity]; const mode = displayState?.attributes?.screen_mode; return !displayState || ['no_hide','hide_sidebar'].includes(mode) ? 'calc(100dvh - var(--header-height, 56px))' : '100dvh'; ]]]

grid.grid-template-areas:
[[[
  return variables.var_camera ? 
    `"status status"  
     "camera camera"
     "camera camera"` :
    `"status status"
     "camera_select camera_select"
     "camera_select camera_select"`;
]]]
